input.command:
python3 -c '
# Let us separate cabinet doors and lamp in obs 94:
# Cabinet doors are beige, lamp shade is yellow-beige:
# In obs 94, cabinet doors are around x in [190, 246]! The lamp shade is on the right around x in [370, 435]!
import cv2, numpy as np
img = cv2.imread("/work/observations/obs_0094.png")
mask = (img[:,:,2] > 180) & (img[:,:,2] < 230) & (img[:,:,1] > 150) & (img[:,:,1] < 200) & (img[:,:,0] > 115) & (img[:,:,0] < 165)
# Cabinet doors: only x < 260
ys, xs = np.where(mask[:, :260])
print(f"True cabinet doors in obs 94: x=[{xs.min()}, {xs.max()}], width={xs.max()-xs.min()+1}, bottom_y={ys.max()}, center_x={xs.mean():.1f}")
'
